verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Memories let ChatGPT (and Codex) carry useful context from earlier chats into future work. Codex CLI's /memories command controls whether a chat uses existing memories or contributes to future ones, and Projects supply shared context across related chats. The evidence is only short doc snippets with no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: detail on how relevant memories are selected and applied, how ChatGPT users view, edit, or delete memories, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-chat memory working.
